details.description: Nous Hermes Llama2 70B is a 70-billion-parameter chat model that Nous Research fine-tuned from Meta's Llama 2 70B base, using the same corpus of more than 300,000 mostly GPT-4-generated synthetic instructions as Nous Research's other Hermes-Llama2 models. It targets long-form, low-restriction responses for creative writing, roleplay, and general instruction-following, and is released as an open-weight model under the MIT license.
advantages: Scores 83.13% accuracy on PIQA, per its model card.
Scores 77.51% accuracy on WinoGrande, per its model card.
Scores 86.41% accuracy on the AGIEval SAT English subtask, per its model card.
Its model card reports long responses, a lower hallucination rate, and no OpenAI-style censorship mechanisms in its training data.
disadvantages: English-language training data only, per its model card.
Its model card reports varied performance on specialized reasoning tasks such as logical deduction and geometric reasoning.
4,096-token training context, short next to more recent chat models.

notes: Only the Hugging Face model card was available; no separate maker docs page or host listing was found.
